CCE Master 是 ModelArts 用来管理 AI 作业的内部 Kub: CCE Master is ModelArts' internal Kubernetes control plane for AI jobs on compute-node servers, physically separate from the ModelArts control plane on GC-01—control/compute separation.
ModelArts 管控面是面向用户的 AI 平台管理服务，运行在管理节点的通算: The ModelArts control plane is the user-facing AI platform service on management servers—job scheduling, model management, and inference deployment. It is physically separate from CCE Master on compute nodes (management plane).
CCE 节点接入：昇腾服务器以 Kubernetes Worker Node 身: CCE node join: Ascend servers register as Kubernetes worker nodes; GC-02 CCE Master schedules them with fine-grained NPU allocation.
NSLB（Network Switch Load Balancing）：工作在交: NSLB (Network Switch Load Balancing): switch-side awareness of uplink queue depth; dynamically adjusts ECMP hash weights to spread bursts across equal-cost paths.
作业路径：用户 Job → ModelArts 管控面（GC-01）→ CCE: Job path: user job → ModelArts control plane (GC-01) → CCE API Server (GC-02) → Scheduler → AI rack Ascend BMS.
无阻塞胖树网络：采用多层 CLOS/Fat-Tree 拓扑，每层交换机间具备等价: Non-blocking Fat-Tree: multi-tier CLOS/Fat-Tree with equal bandwidth per tier, 800G ports, full-line-rate AllReduce between supernodes.
Training 服务：接收用户提交的训练 Job，解析资源需求，生成 Pod: Training service: accepts training jobs, parses resource needs, emits Pod specs to GC-02 CCE Master for scheduling on AI nodes.
参数面交换机是 NC-01 网络柜中安装的物理交换设备，专门承载 AI 集群的: Parameter switches in NC-01 are physical devices carrying ScaleOut interconnect for the AI cluster over RoCEv2 Fat-Tree.
KV Cache 原理：大模型生成每个 Token 时需要访问前序所有 Toke: KV Cache: each generated token reuses cached K/V from prior tokens, avoiding recomputation—lower latency, higher throughput.
物理分离原则：管控面属于管理平面，运行在 GC-01 通算服务器；CCE Mas: Separation principle: control plane on GC-01 management servers; CCE Master compute plane on GC-02—linked via internal APIs.
NPLB（Network Path Load Balancing）：工作在端到端: NPLB (Network Path Load Balancing): end-to-end path selection using a global network view to improve bandwidth utilization.
AI 存储节点专为大模型推理优化，通过缓存注意力计算中间结果（Key-Value: AI storage nodes optimize LLM inference by caching attention K/V intermediates, cutting duplicate work and TTFT.
SFS Turbo 文件存储：基于 NFS v3/v4.1，可同时被多台昇腾服务: SFS Turbo file storage (NFS v3/v4.1): concurrently mounted by multiple Ascend servers for shared training checkpoints.
RoCEv2 协议：将 RDMA 封装于 UDP/IP 以太网帧，在保留 RDM: RoCEv2 encapsulates RDMA in UDP/IP Ethernet frames—RDMA latency/CPU bypass on standard Ethernet.
实测效果：在 1000 卡以上规模集群中，NSLB/NPLB 可将 AllRed: At 1000+ accelerators, NSLB/NPLB can raise AllReduce bandwidth utilization from ~60–70% to 90%+.
物理分离：CCE Master（计算平面）在 GC-02，ModelArts 管: Physical separation: CCE Master (compute) on GC-02; ModelArts control plane (management) on GC-01—internal APIs between them.
OBS 对象存储：基于纠删码（Erasure Coding），提供 11 个 9: OBS object storage: erasure-coded 11-nines durability, S3-compatible API for direct dataset access from AI frameworks.
BMS（裸金属服务器）控制面：通过带外管理（IPMI/Redfish）对物理服务: BMS control plane: out-of-band IPMI/Redfish lifecycle for physical servers—key path for AI rack Ascend servers joining the cloud.
UCM 三级缓存架构：HBM（NPU 显存，最快）→ DRAM（节点内存）→ N: UCM three-tier cache: HBM (fastest) → DRAM → NVMe SSD, tiered by access heat.
灵衢互连：通过 BC-01 总线柜的灵衢设备，超节点内 4 台服务器之间实现 U: LingQu interconnect via BC-01 bus rack: UB protocol low-latency extension bus among four supernode servers for large cross-node models.
Inference 服务：管理推理服务生命周期，将模型打包为推理镜像，通过 CC: Inference service: manages inference lifecycle, packages models as images, deploys via CCE to Ascend servers with ELB endpoints.
NSLB 和 NPLB 是运行在参数面交换机上的软件功能特性，不是独立的物理设备: NSLB/NPLB are software features on parameter switches—not separate devices—addressing congestion and tail latency at scale.
灵衢（LingQu）是华为专为超节点方案设计的高速扩展总线互联设备，实现超节点内: LingQu is Huawei's high-speed extension bus for supernodes—ultra-bandwidth, ultra-low-latency memory-semantic links among AI servers.
0 丢包保障：配合 PFC（Priority Flow Control）暂停机制: Zero-loss assurance: PFC pause eliminates RoCEv2 retransmission storms from packet loss.
API Server：唯一的集群管理入口，接收来自 GC-01 ModelArt: API Server: sole cluster entry; accepts ModelArts (GC-01) scheduling requests, validates, persists to etcd.
参数面网络：连接 NC-01 网络柜的参数面交换机，使用 RoCEv2 协议实现: Parameter network: NC-01 switches over RoCEv2 for gradient sync, AllReduce, and collective ops.
BMS 直通：通过裸金属服务器方式运行，避免虚拟化开销，NPU 性能完全暴露给: BMS passthrough: bare metal avoids virtualization overhead—full NPU exposure for LLM inference and large-scale training.
Scheduler（调度器）：根据 NPU 可用量、亲和性规则、带宽等多维资源约: Scheduler: places AI pods on idle Ascend nodes using NPU availability, affinity, bandwidth, and other constraints.
智算柜内每柜部署 1 台昇腾 AI 裸金属服务器，作为 CCE 集群的 Work: Each AI rack hosts one Ascend AI bare-metal server as a CCE worker carrying all training and inference loads.
AOM：聚合 ModelArts 训练作业的实时指标（NPU 利用率、Loss: AOM: aggregates ModelArts training metrics (NPU utilization, loss, throughput) with dashboards and alerts.
超节点间（Scale-Out）：由 NC-01 参数面交换机实现，800G Ro: Inter-supernode (Scale-Out): NC-01 parameter switches, 800G RoCEv2 Ethernet for data-parallel gradient sync.
协议：基于 LingQu UB（Unified Bus）专有协议，专为 AI 集: Protocol: LingQu UB (Unified Bus) proprietary protocol optimized for AI cluster traffic—high bandwidth, low latency.
OBS 和 SFS Turbo 数据面节点运行在通算柜的存储型服务器上，是 AI: OBS and SFS Turbo data-plane nodes on general compute storage servers back training datasets and model artifacts.
NAT Gateway：为 VPC 内无公网 IP 的资源提供 SNAT 出公网: NAT Gateway: SNAT for VPC resources without public IPs; DNAT for port forwarding.
工作流引擎（Pipeline）：支持数据处理→训练→评估→部署的自动化 AI 流: Pipeline engine: automated data→train→eval→deploy flows with built-in HPO.
高效集合通信：与参数面 RoCEv2 网络协同，灵衢承载对延迟极敏感的张量并行通: Efficient collectives: LingQu for latency-sensitive tensor parallel; parameter RoCEv2 for high-throughput data parallel.
Public 服务：提供 ModelArts 控制台、API 网关和用户认证，是: Public service: ModelArts console, API gateway, and authentication—the unified user entry.
CCAE 是 HCS 的统一运维管理平台，管理数据中心内所有物理和虚拟资源，覆盖: CCAE is HCS unified operations, managing all physical/virtual resources across general compute, AI, bus, and network racks.
跨请求 Prefix Cache：对系统提示词等公共前缀，实现多用户共享 KV: Cross-request prefix cache: shared KV for common system prompts improves concurrent inference.
etcd：分布式 KV 数据库，存储集群所有资源对象（Pod、Node、Job: etcd: distributed KV store for cluster object state (pods, nodes, jobs) with strong consistency.
vRouter：实现 VPC 内子网间路由，以及 VPC 与公网之间的互通，支持: vRouter: intra-VPC and VPC–Internet routing with ECMP high availability.
ELB（弹性负载均衡）：为 AI 推理服务提供 L4/L7 流量分发，支持健康检: ELB: L4/L7 load balancing for inference with health checks, session stickiness, SSL offload.
CloudShell：免客户端 Web 终端，预置 kubectl、Huawei: CloudShell: clientless web terminal with kubectl, Huawei Cloud CLI, etc.
内存语义访问：支持 AI 服务器跨节点直接读写对方 HBM 显存，实现类似 NV: Memory semantic access: cross-node direct HBM reads/writes similar to remote NVLink semantics.
超节点内（Scale-Up）：由 BC-01 灵衢 UB 设备实现，专用协议，极: Intra-supernode (Scale-Up): BC-01 LingQu UB, proprietary low-latency protocol for tensor parallel.
IAM：统一管理用户、角色和权限策略，支持 SAML/OIDC 联邦登录和细粒度: IAM: unified users, roles, policies; SAML/OIDC federation and least-privilege authorization.
连接所有机柜服务器的 BMC 端口，实现远程电源控制、Serial-over-L: Connects BMC ports on all rack servers for remote power, Serial-over-LAN, and hardware health.
HCS IaaS 控制面以虚拟机或容器形式运行在通算柜的通用服务器上，提供云底座: HCS IaaS control plane runs as VMs/containers on general compute servers—full cloud infrastructure control.
CloudShell 提供基于浏览器的云端命令行访问入口；CES 为云上资源提供: CloudShell: browser cloud CLI; CES: unified cloud monitoring and alerting.
Controller Manager：持续对账集群期望状态与实际状态，负责故障重: Controller Manager: reconciles desired vs. actual cluster state—rescheduling, replica maintenance.
混合并行策略：AI 框架可感知超节点拓扑，张量并行走灵衢通道，数据并行走参数面网: Hybrid parallel: frameworks aware of supernode topology—tensor parallel on LingQu, data parallel on parameter network.
带外管理交换机承载所有服务器的 IPMI/BMC/Redfish 管理流量，与业: Out-of-band switch carries IPMI/BMC/Redfish management traffic, physically isolated from data plane.
连接拓扑：仅连接超节点内的昇腾 AI 裸金属服务器（AI-01~AI-04），不: Topology: only intra-supernode Ascend bare-metal servers (AI-01~AI-04)—no storage/management traffic.
ScaleOut 互连指超节点之间的高速集合通信网络，是分布式 AI 训练横向扩: ScaleOut interconnect: high-speed collectives between supernodes—core infra for horizontal AI training scale.
EIP（弹性公网 IP）：管理公网 IP 地址的分配与绑定，支持带宽限速和 SN: EIP: public IP allocation/binding with bandwidth limits and SNAT/DNAT.
支持无限扩展：参数面交换机的胖树架构支持超节点数量线性扩展，理论上可扩展至万卡量: Linear supernode scaling via parameter switch Fat-Tree—theoretically to 10k+ accelerator clusters.
CES 云监控：采集 VM、BMS、CCE 节点、网络等各维度指标，支持自定义告: CES monitoring: metrics from VMs, BMS, CCE nodes, networks—custom alerts and dashboards.
ECN + DCQCN 拥塞控制：动态调节发送端速率，在保障 0 丢包的前提下最: ECN + DCQCN congestion control: adjusts send rate for zero loss while maximizing bandwidth.
网络节点以软件形式运行在通算柜的通用服务器上，承载业务区的南北向和东西向网络流量: Network nodes as software on general compute servers handle north-south and east-west traffic.
支持 DAG 式流水线定义，节点类型包括数据预处理、特征工程、分布式训练、模型评: DAG pipelines with preprocessing, feature engineering, distributed training, evaluation, deployment nodes.
AI Pipeline 工作流引擎为数据科学家提供可视化、自动化的 AI 全流程: AI Pipeline gives data scientists visual, automated end-to-end AI orchestration.
ECS（弹性云服务器）控制面：负责虚拟机生命周期管理，包括创建、启停、快照、迁移: ECS control plane: VM lifecycle—create, start/stop, snapshot, migrate.
显著指标：KV Cache 命中率每提升 10%，推理首包延迟可降低约 20%~: KV cache hit rate +10% can cut first-token latency ~20–40%.
物理隔离：管理网与业务网采用独立 VLAN 或独立物理链路，防止业务故障影响运维: Physical isolation: separate VLAN/links for management vs. data plane.
身份认证与密钥管理是整个 HCS 云平台安全体系的基础，保护管理面和数据面的访问: Identity and key management underpin HCS security for management and data planes.
DNS：为 AI 服务和内部微服务提供域名解析，支持私有域和公共 DNS 递归解: DNS: name resolution for AI services and microservices—private zones and public recursion.
支持极速型（NVMe SSD）规格，可提供数十万 IOPS 和数 GB/s 吞吐: Extreme (NVMe SSD) tiers deliver hundreds of thousands of IOPS and multi-GB/s throughput.
KMS：提供对称/非对称密钥的生命周期管理，符合 FIPS 140-2 合规要求: KMS: symmetric/asymmetric key lifecycle management, FIPS 140-2 aligned.
内置 HPO（超参调优）模块，支持贝叶斯优化、Grid Search 等搜索策略: Built-in HPO with Bayesian optimization, grid search, etc.
支持断点续训：任务中断后可从最近 Checkpoint 恢复，节省大模型训练成本: Checkpoint resume after interruption saves large-model training cost.
LTS：统一收集所有容器和服务的日志流，支持全文检索、结构化查询和实时流式处理。: LTS: unified log streams with full-text search, structured queries, streaming.
IMS（镜像管理服务）：管理操作系统镜像仓库，支持公共镜像、私有镜像及镜像共享。: IMS: OS image registry—public, private, shared images.
AIOps 智能运维：基于 AI 算法进行故障预测、根因分析和自动化修复建议。: AIOps: AI-driven fault prediction, root-cause analysis, remediation suggestions.
EVS（弹性云硬盘）控制面：管理块存储卷的创建、挂载、快照，元数据持久化存储。: EVS control plane: block volume create/mount/snapshot with persistent metadata.
健康度评估：持续采集 CPU/NPU/内存/磁盘/网络等指标，生成健康评分。: Health scoring from continuous CPU/NPU/memory/disk/network metrics.
VPN（IPSec/SSL）：加密通道连接企业私有网络与 HCS 云底座。: VPN (IPSec/SSL): encrypted links between enterprise networks and HCS.
与 CCE 集成，自动采集 Pod 日志和事件，帮助快速定位训练失败根因。: CCE integration captures pod logs/events to pinpoint training failures.
VPC（虚拟私有云）控制面：管理虚拟网络拓扑、子网、路由表、安全组规则等。: VPC control plane: virtual topology, subnets, routes, security groups.
与 BMS 控制面和 CCAE 集成，实现带外状态数据的统一采集和可视化。: Integrates with BMS control plane and CCAE for unified out-of-band telemetry.
所有控制面服务均以高可用集群部署，并与 CCAE 对接实现统一运维监控。: All control-plane services run HA clusters integrated with CCAE monitoring.
所有控制面 API 均需经过 IAM Token 鉴权，保障多租户隔离。: All control-plane APIs require IAM token auth for multi-tenant isolation.
与 OBS/SFS 存储深度集成，自动挂载数据集和模型文件到训练容器。: Deep OBS/SFS integration auto-mounts datasets and models into training containers.
提供对外互联互通能力，支持私有数据中心与 AI 业务区之间的安全通信。: Secure connectivity between private data centers and AI zones.
告警与工单：与 AOM、LTS 深度集成，自动生成运维工单并推送通知。: Alerts/tickets integrated with AOM/LTS—auto tickets and notifications.
统一纳管：对接所有机柜的服务器、交换机、存储设备，形成统一资产视图。: Unified inventory of servers, switches, storage across all racks.
AOM 和 LTS 共同构成 AI 平台的可观测性基础设施。: AOM and LTS together form the AI platform observability stack.
